text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
I'm so happy...!
choice_data_list: Let's keep doing our best together!
Let's keep doing our best together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm fine. Looking at this makes me feel like strength is welling up from deep inside me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. Trainer, you take
one of the plushies, too."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're always working hard too, Trainer.
That's why I think you need this as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you from now on as well...!
